title: SOS CBOR codec accepts any node string including empty
description: SosAlert::from_cbor stores node as an arbitrary UTF-8 tstr. test/vectors/sos_cbor.json sos_node_format invalid_node_examples include empty string and IPv4. Python POST /sos rejects non-EUI64 node ids. Spec 18.4.2 shows colon-hex IPv6. Codec vs policy: decide one node grammar and reject at decode or at the resource.
close_reason: from_cbor now requires sos_node_format full IPv6 (8 hex groups). Rejects empty, IPv4, and 4-group ids from the vector invalid_node_examples. Builder still accepts in-memory short ids. cargo test sos:: + sos_cbor_vectors passed.
